cues.text: A forty-three-year-old man has a deep laceration to his right wrist after a fight.
and he has lost sensation over his little and ring fingers.
These point to the ulnar nerve. In the hand, its deep branch supplies adductor pollicis,
the hypothenar muscles, the third and fourth lumbricals, and the interossei.
It also gives sensation to the little finger and the medial half of the ring finger.
So a deep wrist laceration with this picture means the ulnar nerve is damaged.
